purpose: A minimal first-party measurement plan for the canonical Zone1 publication. No visitor events are collected in the current GitHub Pages deployment.

collection.blocker: The canonical origin remains GitHub Pages. No persistent same-origin route, authorized runtime, approved privacy/retention notice, host/proxy logging review or production receipt exists. Local contract tests prove compatibility, not a live deployment.

event_policy.storage_model: UTC-day aggregate counts by event, canonical page ID, and allow-listed product ID; no raw event rows are retained.
event_policy.retention_note: Retention is a proposed default for a future deployment, not an active collection setting. Confirm the final privacy notice and retention before enabling collection.
event_policy.deployment_logging_gate: Before enabling collection, verify the host and any reverse proxy do not retain raw IP or user-agent access logs outside an approved notice and retention policy. The reference collector disables its own HTTP access log; that does not control host or proxy logs.
event_policy.measurement_limits: These are accepted event counts, not unique visitors or eligible sessions. DNT/GPC, script blockers and bots affect coverage; Origin checks are not authentication and non-browser requests can be forged. Do not compute order conversion using mismatched measurement windows.

events.name: page_view
events.when: Once per document when a canonical reader page first becomes visible, only after explicit collection enablement and absent DNT or Global Privacy Control.

events.name: outbound_click
events.when: A trusted primary- or middle-button reader activation of a tagged, allow-listed Amazon destination; record the site product slug, never guess an ASIN or tracking ID.

events.name: article_engagement
events.when: A published article or buying guide remains visible and active for the 60-second coarse threshold.

events.name: comparison_interaction
events.when: A trusted activation opens an internal product-guide link from the comparison page; table visibility alone is not an interaction.

events.name: affiliate_report_import
events.when: An authorized Associates Central report is imported; the corresponding aggregate is added to data/campaign-ledger.json.

campaign_ledger.rule: Add a row only from an authorized first-party analytics aggregate or Associates Central report. Preserve the report's timestamp, source, channel, eligible sessions, clicks, and reported orders. Do not infer orders, conversion rate, or revenue from clicks.

cadence.action: Run the generator and link/content gates. The canonical build regenerates the sitemap from indexable pages and the RSS feed from the article register; add a new guide to its data register before publication.

cadence.frequency: Weekly after a collector is deployed
cadence.action: Check endpoint health and aggregate event counts for unexpected drops or spikes. Do not inspect visitor-level records; the collector stores no raw rows. Until deployment, record this check as blocked rather than inventing counts.

cadence.frequency: Monthly after Search Console and Associates access are verified
cadence.action: Save dated aggregate Search Console query/page data and authorized Associates report totals. Add only reported values to the campaign ledger, with source and date range.

cadence.frequency: Quarterly, once measured query data exists
cadence.action: Choose and refresh topics using observed query impressions/clicks, reader questions, and documented product gaps. Treat topic ideas as hypotheses until supported by actual query data.

query_policy: Do not claim topics are trending or high-converting without measured, dated evidence. Search Console query data is unavailable until the owner verifies the property and submits the sitemap; the codebase cannot do those account actions.
